description.en:
Basic Attack

Rover-Havoc performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Rover-Havoc consumes STA to attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
Use Basic Attack after casting Heavy Attack to cast Basic Attack 4.

Mid-air Attack

Rover-Havoc consumes STA to cast a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Rover-Havoc melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.

Heavy Attack

Rover-Havoc mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang, memberikan Havoc DMG.
Gunakan Basic Attack setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack 4.

Mid-air Attack

Rover-Havoc mengonsumsi STA untuk melancarkan Mid-Air Plunging Attack, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en: Transform sound into feathers, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id: Mengubah suara menjadi bulu, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en: Rover gathers resonating sounds to attack targets, dealing Havoc DMG.
description.id: Rover mengumpulkan suara resonansi untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

description.en: In the Dark Surge state, gain 20% Havoc DMG Bonus.
description.id: Dalam status Dark Surge, mendapat 20% Havoc DMG Bonus.

description.en: While in the Dark Surge state, Basic Attack recovers 1 extra Resonance Energy when it hits a target. This effect can be triggered 1 time per second.
description.id: Dalam status Dark Surge, Basic Attack memulihkan 1 Resonance Energy tambahan saat mengenai target. Efek ini dapat dipicu 1 kali per detik.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Devastation

When "Umbra" is full, hold Basic Attack to cast Devastation to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Dark Surge

After casting Devastation, Rover enters the Dark Surge state. In this state:
-Basic Attack is replaced with Enhanced Basic Attack, which performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
-Heavy Attack is replaced with Enhanced Heavy Attack;
-Use Basic Attack after casting Enhanced Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack Thwackblade to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
-Use Basic Attack after casting Heavy Attack Thwackblade to cast Enhanced Basic Attack 3 to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG;
-Resonance Skill Wingblade is replaced with Resonance Skill Lifetaker, transforming sounds into blades to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

Umbra

Rover can hold up to 100 points of Umbra.
Normal Attack Tuneslayer recovers Umbra on hit.
Resonance Skill Wingblade recovers Umbra when cast.
Resonance Skill Lifetaker recovers Umbra when cast.
Intro Skill Instant of Annihilation recovers Umbra when cast.
description.id:
Devastation

Saat "Umbra" penuh, tahan Basic Attack untuk melancarkan Devastation guna menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Dark Surge

Setelah melancarkan Devastation, Rover memasuki status Dark Surge. Dalam status ini:
-Basic Attack digantikan oleh Enhanced Basic Attack, yang melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Havoc DMG.
-Heavy Attack digantikan oleh Enhanced Heavy Attack;
-Gunakan Basic Attack setelah melancarkan Enhanced Heavy Attack untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Thwackblade guna menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
-Gunakan Basic Attack setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack Thwackblade untuk melancarkan Enhanced Basic Attack 3 guna menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG;
-Resonance Skill Wingblade digantikan oleh Resonance Skill Lifetaker, mengubah suara menjadi bilah untuk menyerang target, memberikan Havoc DMG.

Umbra

Rover dapat menampung hingga 100 poin Umbra.
Normal Attack Tuneslayer memulihkan Umbra saat mengenai target.
Resonance Skill Wingblade memulihkan Umbra saat dilancarkan.
Resonance Skill Lifetaker memulihkan Umbra saat dilancarkan.
Intro Skill Instant of Annihilation memulihkan Umbra saat dilancarkan.

description.en: Rover summons a Havoc Field, dealing Havoc DMG of 143.3% of Rover's ATK to all targets within the range every 2s for 6s.
description.id: Rover memanggil Havoc Field, memberikan Havoc DMG sebesar 143,3% ATK Rover kepada semua target dalam jangkauan setiap 2 dtk selama 6 dtk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 30%.
description.id: Resonance Skill DMG Bonus meningkat sebesar 30%.

description.en: Reset Resonance Skill's Cooldown when Rover enters the Dark Surge state by casting Heavy Attack Devastation.
description.id: Mereset Cooldown Resonance Skill saat Rover memasuki status Dark Surge dengan melancarkan Heavy Attack Devastation.

description.en: In the Dark Surge state, Basic Attack 5 restores HP equal to 10% of total HP lost on hit.
description.id: Dalam status Dark Surge, Basic Attack 5 memulihkan HP sebesar 10% dari total HP yang hilang saat mengenai target.

description.en: Heavy Attack Devastation and Resonance Liberation Deadening Abyss reduces enemy's Havoc RES by 10% for 20s on hit.
description.id: Heavy Attack Devastation dan Resonance Liberation Deadening Abyss mengurangi Havoc RES musuh sebesar 10% selama 20 dtk saat mengenai target.

description.en: In the Dark Surge state, Basic Attack 5 deals an additional Havoc DMG equal to 50% of Basic Attack 5 DMG.
description.id: Dalam status Dark Surge, Basic Attack 5 memberikan tambahan Havoc DMG sebesar 50% DMG Basic Attack 5.

description.en: In the Dark Surge state, Rover's Crit. Rate is increased by 25%.
description.id: Dalam status Dark Surge, Crit. Rate Rover meningkat sebesar 25%.
